issue.title: Goal hot read reuses goals-hot.json projection instead of re-reducing every live goal (warm list 38.7 ms vs 5 ms at 1000 unsettled)
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-1bu.7 (epic sase-1bu, SASE Goals G1) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP; triaged by the sase-1bu land agent. See the proposal field for measurements and root cause.

task_type_fields.proposal:
Make the goal hot read projection-aware so a warm `goal_ledger_list` (and the `sase goal list` fast path built on it) reuses cached per-goal results from `~/.sase/projects/<key>/goals-hot.json` for every live goal whose `items/<id>/events/` stat signature `[events_dir_mtime_ns, entry_count]` is unchanged, and re-reduces only goals whose signature moved, as the frozen G1 plan (plan:202609/goal_ledger.md, "Hot projection") specifies.

MEASURED MISS (benchmark file:explicit:1dba5d50c8383526696e7f4f, athena, 2026-09-28, 100k settled + 1000 unsettled):
- Rust warm hot read p50 38.71 ms / p95 38.90 ms vs contract <= 5 ms at 1000 unsettled -> FAIL.
- e2e `sase goal list` fast path p50 67 ms / p95 70 ms at 1000 unsettled (contract is stated at 100 unsettled, where every verdict passes).
- I/O probe per warm list: event_dir_stats 1000, event_files_opened 1000, goals_reduced 1000, settled_event_opens 0. Settled-growth 0 -> 100k p95 change is within 10% (PASS), so the cost is O(unsettled events), not O(history).

ROOT CAUSE: sase-core `goal::ledger::read::goal_ledger_list` re-reads and re-reduces every marked goal on each call (~40 us/goal) and never consults projection signatures; `goal::fast_path::render_fast_list` calls it directly. `goal::ledger::projection` already refreshes and classifies (Missing/SchemaMismatch/Stale/Fresh) but no read path uses the cached rows. The cached `row` alone is not enough for `-j` output, which prints full `GoalStateWire`s, so the projection must either cache the reduced state per goal (bounded by the live count) or the JSON path keeps re-reducing while the terminal path renders from rows.

SCOPE: sase-core read path + projection schema (bump the projection schema_version; the file is machine-local and rebuildable), fast path, binding if the signature changes, sase `sase-core-revision.txt` ratchet, and re-run `just bench-goals` to show warm p50 <= 5 ms at 1000 unsettled with byte-identical list output (fast vs slow path, `-j` and terminal).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The G1 plan (sase-1bu) says a performance miss that needs structural change is recorded as a feature task bead with its measurements and is never planned as a child epic of G1. Phase sase-1bu.7 judged this miss structural (a new read strategy in sase-core plus a projection schema change), and at the contract's stated e2e scale (100 unsettled) every verdict already passes.
